sources.title: Control of goal-directed and stimulus-driven attention in the brain
sources.key_claim: Two partially segregated networks: DAN (goal-directed, FEF+IPS) and VAN (stimulus-driven, TPJ, right-lateralized)

sources.title: Mechanisms of visual attention in the human cortex
sources.key_claim: Competition among multiple stimuli in visual cortex biased by top-down signals from frontal and parietal cortex

sources.title: Attentional modulation of visual processing
sources.key_claim: Attention produces multiplicative gain modulation: response amplitude scaled up, tuning curve shape preserved

sources.title: Selective gating of visual signals by microstimulation of frontal cortex
sources.key_claim: Sub-threshold FEF microstimulation causally enhances V4 responses at retinotopically corresponding locations; effect equivalent to removing competing distractors

sources.title: High-frequency, long-range coupling between prefrontal and visual cortex during attention
sources.key_claim: Attention induces enhanced FEF-V4 gamma-band (30-80 Hz) coherence with 8-13ms time shift, FEF leading; timing matches conduction+synaptic delays for optimal postsynaptic impact

sources.title: Rhythms for Cognition: Communication through Coherence
sources.key_claim: Communication between brain areas is rendered selective by matching oscillatory rhythms: gamma mediates bottom-up, alpha/beta mediates top-down; attention selectively enhances gamma coherence between areas processing attended stimuli

sources.title: A DCM study of spectral asymmetries in feedforward and feedback connections between visual areas V1 and V4 in the monkey
sources.key_claim: Forward (V1→V4) connections employ predominantly gamma frequencies; backward (V4→V1) connections employ alpha/beta frequencies, confirmed by Bayesian DCM

sources.title: Top-down modulation of neural activity in anticipatory visual attention: control mechanisms revealed by simultaneous EEG-fMRI
used_for: IPS inversely correlated with occipital alpha
sources.key_claim: IPS BOLD inversely correlated with occipital alpha; DLPFC and dACC BOLD positively correlated with alpha lateralization magnitude—provides human EEG-fMRI evidence for DLPFC→DAN→sensory alpha control chain

sources.title: High-alpha band synchronization across frontal, parietal and visual cortex mediates behavioral and neuronal effects of visuospatial attention
sources.key_claim: Sustained high-alpha (10-14 Hz) phase synchronization across frontal, parietal and visual cortex underlies visuospatial attention; correlates with RT improvement

sources.title: Dynamics of alpha control: preparatory suppression of posterior alpha oscillations by frontal modulators revealed with combined EEG and event-related optical signal
sources.key_claim: Posterior occipital alpha suppression temporally follows frontal DAN activation, establishing causal direction: frontal→posterior alpha
